items.title: FAQs
items.html:
Can I buy a single flavor once I discover my favorite?
Absolutely! Once you know which flavor your family loves most, feel free to purchase it individually—or explore it in our toothpastes, flosses, or mouth sprays, too.
What is non-fluoride mouthwash?
Non-fluoride mouthwash is a type of oral rinse that does not contain fluoride, a common ingredient found in many traditional mouthwashes. Instead, it relies on Hydroxamin®, (containing nano-hydroxyapatite with vitamins K2 & D3) to freshen breath, kill bacteria, and promote oral health.
Why would someone choose non-fluoride mouthwash over traditional mouthwash?
Some individuals may prefer non-fluoride mouthwash due to concerns about fluoride consumption, especially if they already receive fluoride from other sources such as toothpaste or drinking water.
What are the benefits of using non-fluoride mouthwash?
Non-fluoride mouthwash with hydroxyapatite can still provide benefits such as freshening breath, reducing plaque buildup, and fighting bacteria without the use of fluoride. It may also be a preferred option for those with certain sensitivities or allergies to fluoride.
Can non-fluoride mouthwash be used by children?
Yes, children 6 and older can use non-fluoride mouthwash, but for children younger than 6, it's generally recommended to avoid it since they may not have fully developed their swallowing reflexes. For older children, supervision is key to ensure they spit it out properly.
Can non-fluoride mouthwash be used as a substitute for brushing and flossing?
Non-fluoride mouthwash is not a substitute for brushing and flossing, which are essential components of good oral hygiene. While no fluoride mouthwash can complement these practices by freshening breath and reducing bacteria, it should not replace thorough mechanical cleaning of the teeth and gums.

items.title: HOW TO USE
items.html:
• Shake well before each use.
  • Measure out 10 ml of mouthwash.
  • Swish vigorously for 1 minute, ensuring the mouthwash reaches all areas of your mouth.
  • Spit out—do not rinse with water, so the nano-hydroxyapatite can keep working.
  • For best results, use first thing in the morning and last thing at night before bedtime.
